title: The Truman Show
overview: Truman Burbank is the star of 'The Truman Show', a 24-hour-a-day reality TV program that broadcasts every aspect of his life without his knowledge. His entire hometown is an enormous set, and everyone around him is an actor. He slowly begins to discover that his entire life is a lie, orchestrated by an eccentric television producer.

title: Inception
overview: Cobb, a skilled thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology, is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a C.E.O., but his tragic past may doom the project and his team. A man trapped inside layered dreams within dreams struggling with subconscious projections and reality.

title: Interstellar
overview: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage. A father travels through space and time dimensions to save humanity and reconnect with his daughter across alternate dimensions.

title: Shutter Island
overview: World War II soldier-turned-U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels investigates the disappearance of a patient from Boston's Shutter Island Ashecliffe Hospital. He slowly discovers a dark web of deception, psychological secrets, and shocking revelations about his own past and mental sanity in an intense psychological thriller with an unexpected ending.

title: The Matrix
overview: Set in the 22nd century, The Matrix tells the story of a computer hacker who joins a group of underground insurgents fighting the vast and powerful computers who now rule the earth. He discovers the world he lives in is a simulated computer reality known as the Matrix, and his entire previous existence was simulated deception.

title: Fight Club
overview: A ticking-time-bomb insomniac and a slippery soap salesman channel primal male aggression into a shocking new form of therapy. Their concept catches on, with underground 'fight clubs' forming in every town, until an eccentric twist exposes the shocking split identity of the narrator.

title: Memento
overview: Leonard Shelby is tracking down the man who raped and murdered his wife. The difficulty of locating his wife's killer, however, is compounded by the fact that he suffers from a rare, untreatable form of short term memory loss. An intricate psychological puzzle with non-linear storytelling.

title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
overview: Joel Barish, heartbroken that his girlfriend Clementine underwent a medical procedure to erase him from her memory, decides to do the same. However, as he watches his memories of her fade away, he realizes he still loves her and tries to hide her inside the depths of his subconscious mind. A lonely person searching for meaning and love in life.

title: Her
overview: In the near future in Los Angeles, a lonely, introverted man in the final stages of a divorce develops an unlikely romantic relationship with an artificially intelligent operating system designed to meet his every emotional need. A thoughtful exploration of loneliness, human connection, and finding meaning in an isolated modern existence.

title: Donnie Darko
overview: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident involving a jet engine crashing into his bedroom, a troubled and troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a sinister six-foot rabbit named Frank who manipulates him into committing a series of crimes while teaching him about time travel, alternate universes, and the end of the world.

title: The Prestige
overview: A mysterious story of two magicians whose intense desire to create the ultimate stage illusion turns into a perilous game of one-upmanship with deadly results. Features Victorian London, twin identities, scientific obsession, Nikola Tesla, and a staggering climax.

title: Coherence
overview: On the night of an astronomical anomaly, eight friends at a dinner party experience a troubling chain of reality-bending events. As a passing comet affects quantum coherence, they discover alternate versions of their house and themselves in adjacent realities, leading to paranoia and suspicion.

title: Arrival
overview: Taking place after alien crafts land around the world, an expert linguist is recruited by the military to determine whether they come in peace or are a threat. As she learns to communicate with the extraterrestrial beings, she experiences non-linear time perception and memories of her future child, discovering that time is not a straight line.

title: Blade Runner 2049
overview: Thirty years after the events of the first film, a new blade runner, LAPD Officer K, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos. K's discovery leads him on a quest to find Rick Deckard, a former LAPD blade runner who has been missing for 30 years, questioning his own artificial identity and memories.

title: Parasite
overview: All unemployed, Ki-taek's family takes peculiar interest in the wealthy and glamorous Parks for their livelihood until they get entangled in an unexpected incident. A gripping black-comedy thriller exploring extreme social inequality, deception, and class divide.

title: The Dark Knight
overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets. The partnership proves to be effective, but they soon find themselves prey to a reign of chaos unleashed by a rising criminal mastermind known to the terrified citizens of Gotham as the Joker.

title: Pulp Fiction
overview: A burger-loving hit man, his philosophical partner, a drug-addled gangster's moll and a washed-up boxer converge in this sprawling, comedic crime caper. Their adventures unfurl in three eccentric, non-linear stories of crime, redemption, and coincidence.

title: Whiplash
overview: Under the direction of a ruthless instructor, a talented young drummer begins to pursue perfection at any cost, pushing his physical and mental sanity to the breaking point. An intense psychological battle of mentorship, obsession, and music.

title: Spirited Away
overview: A young girl, Chihiro, becomes trapped in a strange new world of spirits. When her parents undergo a mysterious transformation, she must call upon the courage she never knew she had to free her family. An enchanting masterpiece of loneliness, identity, and courage.

title: The Sixth Sense
overview: A child psychologist tries to help a disturbed young boy who communicates with spirits and ghosts of the dead. He guides the terrified boy to use his extraordinary ability, leading to one of the most famous psychological plot twists in cinematic history.

title: Beverly Hills Cop
overview: A freewheeling Detroit cop pursuing a murder investigation finds himself dealing with the very different culture of Beverly Hills.

title: Good Will Hunting
overview: Will Hunting, a janitor at M.I.T., has a gift for mathematics, but needs help from a psychologist to find direction in his life and overcome childhood trauma.

title: Titanic
overview: 101-year-old Rose DeWitt Bukater tells the story of her life aboard the Titanic, 84 years later. A young aristocrat falls in love with a kind but poor artist aboard the luxurious, ill-fated R.M.S. Titanic.

title: The Shining
overview: Jack Torrance accepts a caretaker job at the Overlook Hotel, where he, along with his wife Wendy and their son Danny, must live isolated from the rest of the world for the winter. But they aren't prepared for the madness that lurks within.

title: Forrest Gump
overview: A man with a low IQ has accomplished great things in his life and been present during significant historic events—in each case, far exceeding what anyone imagined he could do. Yet, his true love eludes him.
